title: RINsanity Returns
summary:
The impact of the Renewable Fuel Standard on U.S. refiners
Last weekend, Philadelphia Energy Solutions (PES), the largest oil refinery on the U.S. East Coast, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.
